topic: Vibe Accessibility: Why AI-Generated Code Fails a11y (and How to Fix It)

competitors.title: Accessibility in Vibe Coding: Why It Must Live in the First Prompt, Not in a Final Audit
key_points: Accessibility must be a constraint in the first prompt, not patched in a final audit - fixing later costs 5x more
18-commit WCAG 2.2 AA refactoring on a hand-coded PHP site, proving even hand-written code misses accessibility
86 WCAG 2.2 criteria with 9 new vs 2.1: focus not obscured, dragging alternatives, target size 24x24px, accessible authentication
Specific fixes: keyboard trap in arrow-key navigation, dark/high-contrast themes without FOUC, skip links with ARIA landmarks
44px touch targets for mobile, ARIA form validation, print stylesheet - all real-world examples
Vibe coding amplifies accessibility debt because LLMs execute specs, not intentions - if the prompt says nothing about a11y, the output won't have it
Key lesson: explicit skills/rule files beat generic prompts every time for accessible code generation

competitors.title: Accessibility Risks in AI-Generated Interfaces: WCAG and Real-World Failures
key_points: 96% of home pages contained WCAG compliance failures (WebAIM 2023), likely worsened with generative AI surge
ACM study of 6 AI-built websites found 308 distinct accessibility errors - over half cognitive, rest technical WCAG 2.2 violations
AI-generated interfaces are dynamic by nature, breaking WCAG's assumption of consistency - fluidity creates a perfect storm for a11y failures
Three common failure areas: missing semantic structure, inaccurate alt text (73% of AI-generated alt text wrong or meaningless per AudioEye 2024), broken keyboard navigation
AI-generated interfaces score 42-58% on automated scans vs 65-78% for traditional web apps; remediation requires 37% more effort
Legal landscape tightening: CA AB-331 (Jan 2026), EU AI Act, ADA settlements, Section 508 refresh - accessibility compliance market projected $4.7B by 2027 (Gartner)
Only 30% of WCAG issues caught by automated tools - human testing essential; 87% of assistive tech users encounter AI interface failures weekly

competitors.title: Vibe fixing: How to validate AI-generated code and achieve accessibility at the speed of AI
key_points: Introduced 'vibe fixing' - retroactively correcting AI-generated code for accessibility before shipping
Real AI-generated React/Figma code showed: no heading structure, overuse of generic spans, no landmarks, non-focusable links, buttons without accessible names
Deque's axe MCP Server enables in-IDE accessibility testing via natural language, integrates with Cursor/Copilot/Windsurf
MCP-based workflow: analyze -> remediate -> re-analyze in seconds within the IDE, closing the accessibility testing loop
Vibe fixing is the accessibility counterpart to vibe coding - both AI-powered, enabling speed without sacrificing compliance

competitors.title: Can AI Agent Skills Help Developers Ship Accessible Code?
key_points: 95% of home pages showed detectable WCAG failures in 2025 (WebAIM); AI-generated code scales these failures rather than fixing them
AI coding agents learned from public repos - a web that already fails on accessibility - so they reproduce those failures
Anthropic introduced Agent Skills (Oct 2025), open-sourced Dec 2025 - SKILL.md files as progressive-disclosure guidance for agents
Intopia Web Accessibility Skill tested with GPT-5.3 Codex: without the skill, 14+ accessibility issues across a multi-step form
With the accessibility skill: only 1 remaining issue (focus management) - contrast checked programmatically, semantic structure correct
Skills force agents to think about accessibility during code generation, not in a cleanup phase - raises the baseline significantly

competitors.title: Vibe Coding Accessibility - CSUN 2026 Conference Presentation (Karl Groves)
key_points: GitHub repo accompanying CSUN 2026 talk on Vibe Coding Accessibility presented March 2026
Contains prompt templates and AI coding tool output analysis for accessibility evaluation
Real-world testing of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex) against WCAG criteria
Practical methodology for developers to evaluate AI-generated code for a11y before shipping
